title: Steve Sarkisian blames "society" for Colin Simmons's bizarre unsportsmanlike conduct foul

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Steve Sarkisian blames "society" for Colin Simmons's bizarre unsportsmanlike conduct foul
sources.description: To cap a week in which the NFL went overboard with fines, Texas defensive end Colin Simmons did something that possibly would have gotten him banned for life by 345 Park Avenue.
